estimates.anchor_source: No market prices 3Q26 margin (Kalshi KXABNB nights ladder and Polymarket price ladders only, 2026-09-17T03:34:27Z). Anchor = M5 dispersion-conditioned Street composite 50.19% (LSEG 11 Sep 2026 49.78%, n 36, plus shrunken bias), sd 1.34pp from its P(margin beat) 0.62 -> P(>=51.5) 0.16. Base rate: quarterly ceiling sentences exceeded by >=1.4pp, 0-1 of 10 (Laplace 0.17). Decomposition: cost-stack Monte Carlo datasets/r05_model.py.
estimates.independence_note: three objects (sentence record, cost stack, Street plus bias) all land at 0.16-0.19; agreement, not deference

model.structure: revenue N(4804, 50); cash costs = 2405 + N(0, 60) + 0.20 x (revenue - 4804) - slip x U(30, 97) with P(slip) 0.25; margin = 100 x (revenue - costs) / revenue; YES <=> margin >= 51.5
model.revenue_leg: 51.5% needs cash costs <= $2,330M at $4,804M (-$75M vs budget), <= $2,301M at the Street's $4,744M; if all in S&M: S&M <= $706M = +20.7% y/y vs the budget's +33.5% and 1H26's +26-34%

impact.note: At 51.5% vs the card's 49.94%: +$75M of 3Q26 EBITDA, FY26 +0.5pp, FY27 +0.4pp (half-weight timing vs run-rate), FY27 EPS +$0.09; stock +$3 (EBITDA surprises carry no day-1 information; level effect ~+$1.6 plus a higher chance of the 'approximately 36%' FY26 sentence). EV 0.17 x 3 = $0.5/share: immaterial; drop as a stock risk, keep the S&M arithmetic as the reply to 'the sentence is sandbagged'.
